_about: Numbers cited by the agentic-device-control kit. Every entry has class 'public' (a cited public paper or documentation page, value as published) or 'illustrative' (a round number invented to explain an idea; never a measurement). No number here is copied from any internal source. Derived values in the notes are labelled 'my arithmetic'. Load this file; do not retype the numbers.
